name: offline-switchboard
description: Discoverable offline reference bundle: drives a synthetic switchboard through the real Jev Loop kernel with no network, no model call and no external device.
when_to_use: Use it to check that the bundle standard, discovery, the managed host and the kernel work end to end on a machine with no credentials; read it as the worked example when writing a bundle that does touch a real environment. Do not use it as evidence that any user task was performed.

output.description: The controller snapshot carries the world state, the step count and the verifier verdict; the run journal (events.jsonl) is the evidence trail.

python: jev-loop (this repository) — the kernel and the mock environment

resources.notes: This reference holds no external input. A real adapter must declare the input it owns (for example browser:<profile>) and the caller must pass the same key in resource_keys.

stop.release: LoopController.request_stop releases synchronously through the controller's release callback; the run is only stopped once it is terminal and resources_released is true

verification.notes: SwitchboardEnvironment holds the ground truth, the policy only picks among offered candidates, and SwitchboardVerifier re-reads the world instead of trusting the observation.
